DISCLAIMER
This advisory is prepared for general information purposes only for Fijian consumers and relevant stakeholders. It is based on publicly available data. Any prices quoted are global wholesale or specific retail observations and will differ across Viti
Levu, Vanua Levu, and the Outer Islands due to freight and regulated margins. Market conditions are volatile; readers should monitor official FCCC updates for regulated price changes.
